source.notes: Official Plenergy station pages expose an electric-charger 'Precio KW' field on a per-station basis. Some stations currently expose a numeric value and others expose a blank value, so tariff coverage must be station-specific and fail closed. Official Plenergy material confirms Plenoil was renamed Plenergy.

scope.include: Physical Plenergy/legacy Plenoil service stations in Spain where the official station page exposes a numeric electric-charging Precio KW value.
exclude: stations whose official Precio KW field is blank
third-party charging points merely near or interoperable with a Plenergy site
historical third-party observations not confirmed by the current official station page

integrationRule: Match the exact physical Plenergy station to its official station page and ingest only a currently numeric Precio KW. If the field is blank or the station identity is ambiguous, leave the tariff unresolved. Do not generalize 0.36 EUR/kWh or any other observed value across the network.
